name: dev
title: Requirements-driven development
description: Classify a task, settle its business and technical requirements as deep as it needs, implement against them, verify independently and open a pull request ready for QA.

requirementsDir.description: Directory (relative to the project root) with one folder of requirements per feature, plus the index, shared glossary and project tech design baseline; must not contain taskNotesDir

requirementsFile.description: File name of a feature's business requirements (Gherkin rules and glossary) inside its folder

techDesignFile.description: File name of a feature's technical requirements inside its folder; the same name at the root of the requirements directory is the project baseline

taskNotesDir.description: Directory (relative to the project root) for task briefs: the original request, classification, change requests and the Dev QA report; Ship removes each brief once the pull request holds its record; must lie outside requirementsDir

mainBranch.description: Default branch that task branches start from and pull requests target

testCommand.description: Command that runs the full test suite; leave empty to let the flow find it and ask you on first use

checkCommand.description: Command that runs the other checks CI runs (lint, type check, build), chained with &&; leave empty to let the flow find it

sensitivePaths.description: Comma-separated path globs whose changes always need human review (for example auth/**, migrations/**)

featureBranchPrefix.description: Prefix for your feature branch names

fixBranchPrefix.description: Prefix for your bug fix branch names

reviewer.description: GitHub handle (without the leading @) to request pull request reviews from; leave empty to choose per pull request

classify-task.description: Classify a task, record its original request in a task brief and choose how deep the flow goes. Use when starting any task or when a later step sends it back.

NEXT.description: The developer confirmed a route that changes business requirements

TECH_ONLY.description: The developer confirmed a route that changes no business rule but changes technical requirements or UI placement

CODE_ONLY.description: The developer confirmed a route without requirement changes: a cited requirement is violated, or a technical change fits the existing requirements

OUT_OF_SCOPE.description: The task will not end in a change to this repository and the developer agreed to close it

define-behavior.description: Write or update the business requirements of the affected features in Gherkin with a glossary and get them accepted. Use when the route changes business rules.

NEXT.description: The developer accepted the requirements and they affect technical requirements

NO_TECH_IMPACT.description: The developer accepted the requirements and the no-technical-impact check passed

RECLASSIFY.description: The task turned out to need another class or route

design-tech.description: Screen quality attributes and write the long-lived technical requirements of the affected features, then get them accepted. Use when the route includes tech design.

NEXT.description: The developer accepted the tech design

REQUIREMENTS_GAP.description: The design needs a business rule or glossary term the requirements do not have

implement-task.description: Implement the task test-first against its accepted requirements and tech design, discussing every requirement change. Use when requirements are settled or work was sent back.

NEXT.description: Every in-scope requirement is implemented and tested, the checks pass and every change request is decided

REVISE_REQUIREMENTS.description: A business requirement change is too big to make in place, or the developer chose to revise it there

REVISE_DESIGN.description: A tech design change is too big to make in place, or the developer chose to revise it there

verify-task.description: Verify independently that every in-scope requirement is met and every change maps to a requirement. Use in a fresh session after implementation.

NEXT.description: Every check passed; sensitive changes are listed for human review

FAILED.description: A requirement is not met, a check failed or a change maps to no requirement

REQUIREMENTS_GAP.description: The change needs a business rule the requirements lack, or a user-visible change skipped the behavior step

DESIGN_GAP.description: The change needs a technical requirement the tech design lacks, or contradicts the quality attribute screening

ship-task.description: Push the verified branch, open a pull request that becomes the task's record, then remove the task brief. Use when Dev QA passed.

NEXT.description: The pull request is open and CI is green, or the hand-off says what is not available

CHANGES_REQUESTED.description: Pull request reviewers or CI require code changes

done.description: Dev QA passed and the pull request is open: the task is ready for the QA team.

not-handled.description: The task was closed without changes.
